visual_action: A static photograph of Joe Biden and Kamala Harris standing side-by-side and smiling at each other. The image has a dark, neutral background. Text and emoji overlays appear sequentially over the photograph.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Joe Biden is shown in a photograph for the entire duration of the video.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Kamala Harris is shown in a photograph for the entire duration of the video.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The on-screen text asks viewers if they "Want to go vote for Democrats".

on_screen_text.text: “Want to go vote for Democrats up and down the ballot in midterm elections?”

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in this video.
audio_music: An upbeat, driving indie/psychedelic rock track ('Let It Happen' by Tame Impala) plays throughout the video.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single static image with text and emoji overlays that change a few times.
cultural_references: The song 'Let It Happen' by Tame Impala is used.
central_claim: The video encourages viewers to vote for the Democratic party in the midterm elections.
intended_effect: To motivate viewers to vote for Democratic candidates and feel positive and confident about their choice.
